:::{#thm-cv-estimate-by-fold}
#### The cross-validation estimate, fold by fold

The [cross-validation estimate](#def-cv-estimate) sums,
fold by fold,
the squared errors of each fold's observations
under the rule fitted without that [fold](#def-folds),
and divides the total by $n$:

$$
\cvest{k} = \frac{1}{n} \sumto{j}{k} \sum_{i \in \fold{j}} \sqf{\fittedwo{j}{x_i} - y_i}.
$$ {#eq-cv-estimate-by-fold}

:::

::: proof
This is @sol-cv-estimate-by-fold.
:::
